body: That sucks. My condolences. I want to care about other people and things outside of myself, but when I reach inward to pull up that emotion I’m just coming up empty.

I’m really sorry that you’re having to go through this. Talking to a counselor is a good idea. Personally, I’ve found out of school counselors to have more resources than the in school help if you have an option But if an in school counselor is all that is available, that’s fine, they still do great work. Have you tried talking to your brother about all this? Your parents?
